# Presentations

Use 16:9 slides, a light background and consistent typography. Show stable design
ID/rank, actual target labels and a concise method note. Preserve image aspect
ratios and equal panel sizes for comparisons. Include full binder sequences and
a molecule/residue color key when presenting per-design structures.
Ranked decks record selection rules/version and candidate counts. Source each
metric with its scope, units and precision; use N/A for missing values. Keep
explanatory text outside molecular images. Record source tables, renders/cameras,
commands and hashes. Inspect every slide for clipping/overlap and verify that the
file opens with the expected slide count. Reports do not establish binding.
